premises.text: Video creators must soundtrack rapidly growing volumes of YouTube, TV, and film content
premises.evidence_span: 400 hours of video is uploaded to YouTube every single minute, a number that's quadrupled in the past three years. At the same time, 3,000 hours of TV and film is produced every single day. And pretty much all this content needs music

premises.text: Stock tracks are time-consuming, costly (~$40), rights-confusing, poorly fit, and overused
premises.evidence_span: costing around $40 for a three-minute track. The copyright and royalties are really confusing. And it won't fit his video, meaning he has to manually edit it himself. What's more, that same track has been used by thousands of other video creators

premises.text: Patent-pending AI composer generates and produces original music autonomously
premises.evidence_span: We've spent five years building an artificially intelligent music composer. This is patent-pending software that writes original music completely on its own

premises.text: Creators get unlimited unique royalty-free music they can customize instantly at lower cost
premises.evidence_span: it can create an unlimited amount of unique music in a variety of styles that's completely royalty-free, instantly customizable, and far cheaper than the alternatives

premises.text: Retail model: five free tracks per month then about $7 each (~80% cheaper)
premises.evidence_span: five free tracks every month and then pay around $7 for an additional track. This is about 80% cheaper than what you'd pay elsewhere

premises.text: Also license the composer to platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, and Vimeo
premises.evidence_span: license our technology to companies that themselves want to provide music to their users, such as YouTube itself, Twitch, Instagram, Vime, you name it

value.text: Cheap, unique, royalty-free AI music tailored to a video's length and style
value.evidence_span: If your video is 43 seconds long and you need a song that will be bang on, we'll give you one that's no more, no less

causal_links.evidence_span: 80% cheaper than what you'd pay elsewhere

notes: Partition is problem / product / commercial, not a forced desirability-feasibility-viability template; each is separately revisable in the pitch. Beta customer names excluded as traction.
